target: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx

rows.Item: Confirmed: interaction ledger and interaction endpoints
rows.Ruling: Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0024, GAP-0047): rwb-source-data (P1) owns the interaction ledger, its intake rule and GET and POST /cases/{caseId}/interactions. rwb-case (P3) and rwb-integration (P2) read the ledger through the P1 contract; rwb-case does not write the ledger.

rows.Item: Confirmed: feature flag library and endpoints
rows.Ruling: Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0025): feature flags are a platform library owned by PLT, under the platform epic RWB-PLT-LIB. This covers the four feature-flag paths.

rows.Item: Confirmed: rule package registry, rule tables and endpoints
rows.Ruling: Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0026, GAP-0049): rwb-decision (P7) owns the rule package registry, rule rows, rule test cases and the eleven rule package and rule version paths. rwb-case and rwb-access hold no rule package administration; services evaluate a local copy only.

Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0027): rwb-case (P3) is the reference data service owner for GET /admin/lists/{listCode} and the four /admin/reference-loads* paths, split from rwb-access. The role, DoA and template endpoints stay with the services named in Architecture v5 slide 41.
Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0028): POST /admin/workflows/smoke is exposed by the platform (PLT), not by rwb-case.
Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0029): rwb-valuation (S1) owns the valuations. rwb-asset calls rwb-valuation to record a valuation and writes no valuation row.
Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0048): the case_list_row table stays with P1; the case list API and screen stay with P3. Confirm in the verification loop.

Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0050): the DoA table (delegation_limit) stays with P4; only non-DoA parameters and reference data stay with P3. Confirm in the verification loop.

Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0051): lov_value is reference data and stays with P3; P4 keeps only role, scope, masking and DoA tables. Confirm in the verification loop.
Confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026 (D-RCV-60; GAP-0052): partner_user stays with S9 rwb-partner; P4 keeps the internal role model only. Confirm in the verification loop.
